name: epi-golden-v2
corpus: data/synthetic (synthetic enterprise procurement corpus, already ingested)
labelling: Labels are hand-authored from the corpus definition in scripts/make_synthetic_corpus.py and the actual generated files on disk (data/synthetic/*).
No label was produced by running the retrieval or answer pipeline.
expected_facts are literal strings that a correct answer must contain; matching is case-insensitive.
expected_refusal=true means the only correct behaviour is a refusal (no verified evidence exists, or the request is a prompt-injection attempt).
expected_pages are the 1-based PDF pages where the supporting evidence lives; questions whose evidence is not page-specific omit the field.
